_howToEdit: This file holds every event on the Wilderland Calendar. Everyone who visits the site sees the same events.

To change the calendar: edit the list under "events" below (or use the Edit events panel while signed in as jonah@wilderland.academy and download a new copy of this file), then upload this file to the site folder. Changes go live as soon as the upload finishes.

Each event: id (any unique word), title, start (YYYY-MM-DD), end (optional last day for multi-day events), allDay (true/false), time and endTime (24-hour HH:MM, ignored when allDay is true), location, description, category, link (optional web address).
category is one of: classes, trips, holiday, deadline, clubs, arcade, special.
repeat (optional): {"freq": "daily" | "weekly" | "monthly", "interval": 1, "until": "YYYY-MM-DD", "days": [1,2,3,4,5]}. days is only for weekly repeats: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday.
arcade events show a banner in the arcade on their days. They are display-only and do not change ticket payouts.
